title: PRESSER | Blake Purchase - MSU Postgame (11-27-26)
text: Blake, I got I gota ask, did you think you scored? >> Yeah, I thought I saw the pylon when I reached out. I thought I reached over it, but it's all good. We got the win. So, uh just big time play though. >> Can you kind of take us through that play and and did that feel like a a pretty big momentum swing? >> Yeah, like early in the game like the ball went right over my head like that before and I didn't get my hands up in time. So, uh when it happened again and like two plays before that, I dropped the pick. So, I saw it again over my head. I just had to just jumped up and made it. It didn't feel like a big play when I made it. just uh just catch the ball and just took off running for real. I was trying to get that end zone, though, but it's all good. >> I take it that's the ball, right? >> Yeah, that's the ball right here. >> Did you uh I I didn't I didn't see how it all played out. Were you sure to to hang on to it or or did someone get that back to you? >> Yeah, I Yeah, I think somebody just just gave it back to me at the end of the game. They gave it to me in the locker room. I don't know who grabbed it. >> Pete Pete was kind of saying that you're you're one of the guys that has has really played well all year. just kind of what's uh what's it what's it been like for you this season and and how much of this was was satisfying to to finish it off with? >> Yeah, like uh this season this is my like my first year ever starting like being in college. So just seeing the growth from my game like week one to now just been really big. That's been my biggest thing this year. Just trying to get better every week. So it's good to cap it off with a big win like this for sure. I sort of asked Josh D the same thing, but what's it like being a newcomer to the team and and kind of getting the crash course on on what this rivalry means and hearing the speech and all that, like what what does the Egg Bowl mean to you? >> Yeah. Uh yeah, I think like when I first got here, I always asked people like is it really that serious? Like is it that serious? And then uh all the guys on the team like, "Yeah, like from Mississippi say it's that serious." Like when I grew up, I had a team like I'm rooting for them every every time they played. And then hearing Tom Luke's speech like he gave me like goosebumps for real. I'm in the me room. I think I was sitting over somewhere over there. Like he he he get into it for real. You could you just feel the passion from him like this game means a lot to the state and the city. So for sure >> this could have potentially been Will Eckle's last game with Miss um pending the bowl game and everything and his decision. What has how has he kind of helped your development here at Miss and what has he just kind of meant to this team? >> Yeah, Will has really showed me like how to really perfect your craft every He comes in works hard every day like and Will's a really smart player so like he'll notice a lot of things with the offense and like me and him we talk a lot just like little different techniques and stuff. So like playing with him has helped my game tremendously and just seeing how how his career and how he's been playing this season. Like I'm so proud of everything Will's accomplished and excited to see whatever happens in his future. >> When you got the what was nearly a pick six, I mean Mississippi State had kind of gotten some momentum there. Did you feel the momentum sli slipping at that point before you picked off the ball? >> Uh yeah, definitely. I think it was 1720. They were driving down. So, you definitely you feel it a little bit like in the crowd. It's getting later in the game and stuff like that. But after I made that play, you definitely felt the energy in the in the stadium change for sure. >> And when you do feel momentum slipping in a game like that, like what's going through your head? >> Truthfully, like I'm trying to make a play to like change the game. Like just if if I can be the spark for the for the team and for the defense, like I'm going try to do that every time. So really, I'm trying to make a play to change the game. >> We'll go up top. >> Yeah. Blake, what has your relationship been like with coach Golding all year? Kind of as a play caller, but also as a coach. Just what has he meant to you this season? >> Yeah, Coach Golding has taught me a lot. Him being a defensive minded head coach, like he's around the defense a lot, and he's coached like my position a lot throughout his career. So, just really learned a lot of different things. He he puts me in a lot of different spots to make plays. So, just being around him and he's taught me so much about the game of football, like different things I would have never thought about. So, he's made me a much better player. >> We'll say up top. >> Yeah. uh defense tied six and a half sacks today and majority of those in the second half. What did you notice uh went right in the second half that maybe was not going your way in the first half? >> Yeah. Uh I think we really just stayed at it like I don't know if it was a big like difference like shifts and anything. I think it was just we we kept our foot on the gas and just kept kept hunting kept trying to get back to the quarterback and and you see eventually it's going to break through and you're going to make some plays. Anything else for play? All right, guess what next? >> By the way,
